steps: Chop the onion, tomato, capsicum, green chilli and coriander leaves very fine.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and pick out any bits of shell.
Add the salt, turmeric and chilli powder and beat with a fork until frothy.
Stir in the chopped vegetables and coriander.
Heat the oil in a frying pan on medium heat. Don't let it get very hot, or the outside browns before the middle sets.
Pour in the eggs and tilt the pan so they spread into an even round.
Cook on medium for about 2 minutes, until the bottom is set and light golden.
Flip, cook the other side for 1 to 2 minutes, then fold it over and serve hot.
note: Sources used 5 to 15 ml of fat for two eggs, so 10 ml of oil sits in the middle. Onion is raised to 20 g because two of the three sources use more than a spoonful.
